items.name: SOC & Security Operations
items.description: Continuous security monitoring, event log analysis, threat triage, SIEM dashboard creation, and operational alert response.

items.name: Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR)
items.description: Evidence collection, chain of custody preservation, memory forensics, artifact extraction, disk timeline reconstruction, and incident reporting.

items.name: Network Security & Infrastructure
items.description: Designing secure network topologies, configuring firewalls, setting up IDS/IPS rules, VPN tunnels, VLAN isolation, and Packet inspection.

items.name: Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing
items.description: Systematic vulnerability assessment, service enumeration, web application security testing, exploitation, and remediation guidance.

items.name: Threat Intelligence & OSINT
items.description: Open-source intelligence gathering, domain and IP reputation analysis, IOC tracking, and threat actor profiling.

items.name: Cloud Security & Automation
items.description: Automating security checks, monitoring cloud workloads, securing API endpoints, and implementing basic IAM policies.
